description: Sweep vouchers (Belege) and flag VAT problems: foreign suppliers booked as plain domestic expenses (taxRule 9/10) instead of Reverse Charge §13b (taxRule 12/13/14), revenue rules sitting on expense vouchers, tax rates that contradict the chosen rule, sums that do not add up, and the same supplier booked inconsistently across vouchers. Read-only. This is the check that tells you whether your §13b amounts will be reported correctly in the VAT return.
